name: sage-vscode-plugin
description: Independent monorepo for a SageMath VS Code plugin

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sage-vscode/extension-core && npm run build --workspace @sage-vscode/syntax-pack
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @sage-vscode/extension-core && npm run lint --workspace @sage-vscode/syntax-pack
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @sage-vscode/extension-core && npm run test:python
